Sign makes an electronic signature with an audit trail: it records who agreed, when and from which browser, and seals the PDF with a page that lists those steps and fingerprints. It does not add a PAdES, advanced or qualified signature, and signers are identified by their personal link (and access code), not by an identity check. If you need a qualified signature, use a trust service provider.
